name: com.pairiquium.sdk
description: Official Unity SDK for the Pairiquium matchmaking engine. Implements the ticket/WebSocket protocol described in Pairiquium/API-Specs.

samples.description: Game mode and region selection (with an Automatic option), start/cancel search, and visual feedback panels for match-found, error, and connection state. Requires the Input System package (com.unity.inputsystem).

Completes the loop Basic Matchmaking stops short of: after a match is found, two players actually connect and play a real-time 2D arena shooter, relayed by a local backend you run yourself (included, see Backend~/README.md). Requires the Input System package (com.unity.inputsystem).
